ignore_design.reason: the window's three controls are the system's, drawn by the window
icon glyph box: SF Symbols draw to their own metrics; the control containing the icon is compared
wrapper of the title and subtitle, which are compared
column wrapper: widths come from the window layout
section or row wrapper: its position follows from the rows and padding inside, which are compared
picture contents: the sample words, clock and timer are drawn by the output renderer (the design's are HTML text), not by operator controls
the Section element ('Section · arrangement') does not exist in the model: open, needs a feature slice
the Video button: no video element exists: open, needs a feature slice (its place at the right end of the bar is kept)
the 2nd lang. colour row: the second-language colour is not a setting yet: open, needs a feature slice (its row is kept)
the Auto-fit checkbox: no auto-fit exists: open, needs a feature slice (a stepper takes its place)
row wrapper (the Size row also holds the Auto-fit text, not built); its controls are compared
pop-up chevron inside a compared control
the Section list row: no Section element exists: open, needs a feature slice
the per-element eye: no per-element hide exists: open, needs a feature slice
status dot inside a compared pill
bold name inside the caption row, which is compared

ignore_app.reason: the Notes element: the design draws a Section element in this place; Notes is the owner's existing element, seeded there so the list lines up
the Notes row of the element list (see above)
the Notes button: the design has no Notes; it sits left of Current so nothing designed moves
the built-in Standard layout: listed after the operator's layouts; the design shows three presets
